q: Convert 10M DAU × 10 requests/day to average RPS.
a: 100M ÷ 86,400 ≈ 1157 RPS average; plan peaks at 2–3×, so roughly 2300–3500 RPS.

q: What is this lab server's capacity?
a: About 250 RPS: 5 concurrent ÷ 0.02s service time. 100 RPS idles well under the SLO; 240 RPS crosses it.
The committed prediction turns a vague number into a checkable claim — the error between predicted and actual p99 is what trains queueing intuition.
